summary: This video breaks down all damage schools in Dragonheir: Silent Gods to guide players on banner picks and team building. It highlights Dauntless as the highest single-target damage team and Ice Blast as the best budget single-target alternative. For AoE, Toxin and Burn are recommended as the most F2P-friendly options, while Thunderbolt has risen in the meta with new hero additions. Corrosion and Wild are identified as high-investment, late-game teams unsuited for beginners. Essential team requirements such as key enablers and Inspiration thresholds are detailed for each school.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Requires Inspiration 5 and her exclusive artifact to double her output and achieve peak Dauntless damage.

heroes.name: Beldelle
heroes.note: Delivers strong single-target damage right out of the gate and becomes top tier at Inspiration 5.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Serves as the primary damage dealer in the highly accessible F2P Toxin AoE team.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Scales exceptionally well with Enlightenment and functions effectively starting from Inspiration 2.

heroes.name: Durem
heroes.note: Outdamages legacy Burn options like Asketius at Inspiration 5 while remaining accessible as a standard legendary.

heroes.name: Lorentheel
heroes.note: Provides indispensable ultimate skill buffs without which Rally teams cannot function.

heroes.name: Paixton
heroes.note: Essential enabler for Burn teams that performs his role at a single copy without requiring an exclusive artifact.

heroes.name: Saverio
heroes.note: Dominates PvP content with high burst damage but offers minimal utility in PvE.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.note: Requires Inspiration 5, exclusive artifact, and endgame gear to be viable.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Provides vital shields and survival buffs necessary to keep melee damage dealers alive.

meta_changes: Thunderbolt risen to second strongest AoE school following Tariz's release.
Corrosion shifted to an end-game whale team requiring Inspiration 5 on key heroes.
Ozul benched from Shadow teams following a skill rework.
Selva introduced as a top-tier exclusive support for Dauntless setups.
tips: Option Summons banners contain a hidden 1000-summon pity that does not carry over between banners.
Do not build a Rally team unless you own Lorentheel, as he is required for the mechanic to work.
Avoid investing in Corrosion or Wild early, as they require end-game gear and high Inspiration levels.
Target Ice Blast or Toxin for immediate high returns at lower investment costs.
